embeds.title: 🟡 Funnel Builder WordPress Plugin Vulnerability Under Active Exploitation for Payment Data Theft
embeds.description:
A critical vulnerability in the Funnel Builder WordPress plugin affecting over 40,000 WooCommerce stores has come under active exploitation. Sansec reported that unauthenticated attackers are exploiting a flaw that allows injection of malicious JavaScript into checkout pages. The injected code masquerades as Google Tag Manager scripts but actually loads payment skimmers designed to steal credit card numbers, CVVs, and billing addresses. FunnelKit released a patch in version 3.15.0.3 to address the vulnerability.
**Sources:** thehackernews.com • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Unauthenticated request to publicly exposed checkout endpoint
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** reported
[Read source](https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/funnel-builder-flaw-under-active.html)
